name: Lokalise WRITE - Personality.co FA/MA welcome test-name fix 2026-09-25
description: WRITE. Fix wrong test name (Career / Emotional Reactivity) in FA/MA welcome email p1/p5, Personality.co. MODE test = 1 translation.

parameters.jsCode: const sent=$('Payload').first().json.body.keys;const b=$input.first().json;const got={};for(const k of (b.keys||[])){for(const t of (k.translations||[])){got[k.key_id+'|'+t.language_iso]={t:t.translation,unv:t.is_unverified,rev:t.is_reviewed,cs:(t.custom_translation_statuses||[]).map(s=>s.status_id)};}}const bad=[];const okl=[];for(const k of sent){for(const t of k.translations){const g=got[k.key_id+'|'+t.language_iso];if(g&&g.t===t.translation)okl.push({key:k.key_id,iso:t.language_iso,t:g.t,unv:g.unv,cs:g.cs});else bad.push({key:k.key_id,iso:t.language_iso,got:g});}}return [{json:{ok:okl.length,bad,errors:b.errors||[],written:okl}}];
